shop_id.description: The one contractor this booking — and its grant — is for. In v1 this is the shop slug from its find_contractors profile_url.

customer.description: Customer details as provided. Only the fields named in grant.fields are recorded or shared; everything else is dropped.

fields.description: Exactly the customer fields this grant allows GreenPut to share with the one shop named by shop_id. Nothing outside this list moves.

purpose.description: The only purpose a v1 grant can be issued for.

allow_network_reroute.description: May GreenPut re-share this lead with a different shop in the network pool if the named shop cannot take it? A reroute is a re-sharing event and is forbidden unless this is true.

grant.description: The customer’s explicit, per-provider, per-field sharing grant. No grant, an empty grant, or a grant with no contact path is a hard stop: the call errors and nothing is recorded.
